Now that I've finally squared away a couple lingering issues with the latest SimpleDesign updates; I was wondering what your guys opinions is on developing a "master" nightmode theme versus having a separate theme per option. (1 versus 1x1).

This is how I see it;

Master Theme

Pros

  • 1 design that fits all of SimpleDesign
  • Independent from each SimpleDesign release

Cons

  • Limited colorization (it would have to fit all options in the same generic format)

 

1 Per Option

Pros

  • Custom tailored nightmode theme per option

Cons

  • Work on each update exponentiates, reducing any timely releases

This of course depends on what exactly I do when I begin this particular project. I have a few ideas but I haven't begun work on them yet.
Your opinions on developing a "Master" Night-mode theme for SimpleDesign.
